summary:
FieldCast is an online and offline-capable, multilingual Progressive Web App (PWA) that empowers smallholder farmers to make climate-smart agricultural decisions through scientifically informed 3-year, 9-season crop rotation strategies.

The platform integrates NASA Earth observation datasets, including NASA POWER, SMAP, GPM IMERG, MODIS, VIIRS, and GRACE-FO, with farmer-provided soil characteristics and agricultural priorities. Its hybrid agronomic engine evaluates 20 regional crops to generate three tailored crop rotation strategies. An interactive What-If simulator recalculates crop suitability, water requirements, and rotation recommendations under drought, excessive rainfall, and rising temperature scenarios.

FieldCast features an accessible visual interface, multilingual text and voice guidance, and AgriGuide AI, an intelligent agricultural assistant powered by Google Gemini.

By promoting crop diversification, efficient water management, and nitrogen-fixing crops, FieldCast aims to improve soil health, reduce agricultural resource dependency, and strengthen the climate resilience and livelihoods of smallholder farmers.
details:
Project Overview

FieldCast is an intelligent, climate-smart agricultural decision-support platform designed to help smallholder farmers transition from water-intensive monoculture farming to scientifically informed crop diversification. It translates satellite-based Earth observation data into practical, farmer-friendly agricultural recommendations.

NASA Data Integration

FieldCast integrates six NASA Earth observation resources:

  • NASA POWER for meteorological parameters, temperature, solar radiation, and precipitation.
  • SMAP for surface and root-zone soil moisture indicators.
  • GPM IMERG for satellite-based precipitation monitoring.
  • MODIS and VIIRS for vegetation indices and vegetation monitoring.
  • GRACE-FO for terrestrial water storage and groundwater context.

These datasets provide environmental context for evaluating agricultural conditions and supporting climate-informed crop planning.

Agronomic Decision Engine

The platform combines rule-based agronomic logic with AI-assisted capabilities to evaluate 20 regional crops. It considers soil compatibility, seasonal suitability, water requirements, nitrogen fixation, climate conditions, and farmer priorities.

Based on these factors, FieldCast generates three personalized crop rotation strategies covering three years and nine growing seasons.

Farmers can adjust priority sliders to balance maximum profit, minimum water consumption, soil health improvement, climate resilience, reduced fertilizer usage, and faster harvest cycles.

Interactive Climate Stress Simulator

The What-If simulator enables farmers to explore three climate stress scenarios:

  • Severe drought: 35% reduction in rainfall.
  • Excessive rainfall: 35% increase in rainfall.
  • Heatwave: 2°C temperature increase.

When a scenario is selected, the system recalculates crop suitability, water requirements, and crop rotation recommendations to help farmers understand potential climate-related risks.

AgriGuide AI (Krishi Bondhu)

The integrated AgriGuide AI assistant, powered by Google Gemini, provides multilingual agricultural assistance, including crop recommendations, agricultural questions and answers, climate-related farming advice, disease and pest management, fertilizer guidance, irrigation recommendations, and personalized farming support.

Accessibility and Technical Innovation

FieldCast is developed as an online and offline-capable Progressive Web App, designed to remain useful in rural areas with limited internet connectivity.

Its accessibility features include:

  • Multilingual support for Bangla, English, Hindi, and other regional languages.
  • Text-based and voice-based interaction.
  • Visual icon-based, low-literacy-friendly interface.
  • Mobile-responsive design.
  • Simple farmer-friendly navigation.

Core features remain accessible offline, while live NASA data updates and AI-powered services require internet connectivity.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
  • Backend and Database: Firebase, Supabase.
  • AI Integration: Google Gemini API.
  • Hosting: Vercel and GitHub Pages.
  • Development Assistance: Google AI Studio.

Intended Impact

FieldCast aims to reduce dependence on water-intensive monocultures, encourage nitrogen-fixing legumes, improve soil health, and support more efficient agricultural resource management.

Its intended impact includes environmental sustainability, improved farmer economic opportunities, and greater resilience against climate variability, particularly for smallholder farmers in climate-vulnerable regions.
